name: Speaker & Acoustics Planner
summary:
Plan your home theater where it will actually stand – **in your own room, in mixed reality.**

Speaker & Acoustics Planner reads the room scan from your headset's Space Setup: walls, doors, windows and furniture. It finds your screen (or suggests one on the wall you face), takes your seat as the listening position, and places every speaker at the angles home theater standards recommend.

# How it works
- Choose a layout: **2.0, 5.1, 5.1.2, 7.1, 7.1.2 or 7.1.4**
- Speakers go **on the wall, on stands or mixe
